_note: Ed's decisions panel (src/ui/decide.ts; ?decide or F2 in the game) and the pause page's test sliders (Esc: every entry, by group, down the left, with Copy values; Ed, 2026-10-12). Each entry: id, pr (the pull request that added it) and group (that PR's short name: the pause page's heading, "#pr group", newest PR first), label, a one-line note, a control (toggle, choice of 2 to 4 options, or slider with min, max and step), the shipped default, and what it changes: a tuning knob by its path (applied live to the running game) or a URL switch (param; reload: true when the game reads it only as it loads). Confirm opens a new GitHub issue labelled decision with the choice; the coordinator acts on those.

decisions.label: Fade at the foot (m)
decisions.note: How far from its trunk's foot a shadow fades in from nothing (0: none).

decisions.label: Taper at the foot (m)
decisions.note: How far from its foot a shadow opens out from a third of its width, so wide roots don't splay (0: none).

decisions.label: Fade near her (m)
decisions.note: A trunk's shadow fades to nothing as she comes within this distance of the trunk (0: never).

decisions.label: Darkens grass and flowers
decisions.note: How much a shadow darkens the grass, flowers and tufts it falls on (1: as much as the ground; 0: not at all).

decisions.label: Scenery casts shadows
decisions.note: Temples, castles, ruins, set pieces, relics, runestones and soundsystems cast shadows from her glow and the campfires, as the tree trunks do.

decisions.label: Shortest that casts (m)
decisions.note: Scenery shorter than this casts no shadow.

decisions.label: Shadow colour (scenery)
decisions.note: How far scenery's shadows take the complement of the light throwing them (0: black; a campfire's orange throws blue-violet).

decisions.label: Shadow colour (trees)
decisions.note: The same for the trees' and palms' shadows (0: black, as before), to compare.

decisions.label: Glowing casters' shadows
decisions.note: How light the shadows of things lit with their own colour are (runestones, soundsystems), in a soft shade of that colour (0: as dark as any).

decisions.label: Fade at the base (m)
decisions.note: Scenery's shadows (runestones, soundsystems, ruins...) fade in from nothing at their base, over this far past their own edge (0: no fade).

decisions.label: Taper (times its width)
decisions.note: Scenery's shadows are pinched at their base and open out over this share of the piece's width past its edge, so wide ruins and soundsystems open out over more ground than narrow runestones (0: no taper).

decisions.label: Most sound effects at once
decisions.note: The one-shot sound effects allowed at once; past it, the ones that matter least (far creatures, the beds' little details) aren't played and lesser ones playing are cut short for hers and the stings. 0: no limit. Lower it if the sound cuts out.

decisions.label: Sigil strength
decisions.note: How bright every sigil is drawn (placed, runes, ghost, stack, treetops). 0.5 stays under the bloom; lift it if they're faint on bright ground.

decisions.label: Sigil halo
decisions.note: The soft glow under placed sigils, ready runes and relic sigils, times its old strength (0: none).

decisions.label: Island shadow darkness
decisions.note: How dark the islands' moon shadows are on the sea and in their valleys (0 none).

decisions.label: Moon height (degrees)
decisions.note: How high the moon goes; lower makes the shadows longer.

decisions.label: Seconds a turn
decisions.note: How long the moon takes to go once round the chart.

decisions.label: Rise (s)
decisions.note: How long the moon takes to rise over the north-west edge as the chart opens.

decisions.label: Moon disc in the sky
decisions.note: Draw the moon itself past the rim, where it is.

decisions.label: Empty sea round the edge
decisions.note: How far the open sea reaches past the furthest islands, as a share of their radius.

decisions.label: Shadow darkness
decisions.note: How dark a trunk's or palm's shadow is at its darkest (near its foot and the light).

decisions.label: Shadow length (times the trunk)
decisions.note: The longest a shadow stretches, times its trunk's height.

decisions.label: Her glow's reach (m)
decisions.note: How far from her a trunk still casts a shadow from her glow (fading to nothing at the edge).

decisions.label: Her glow's height (m)
decisions.note: How high her glow casts from: lower makes longer shadows.

decisions.label: Shadow style
decisions.note: Soft (a blurred silhouette, as dark as hard at its core), hard (on the art's pixels, two tones) or off.

decisions.label: Soft shadow's core
decisions.note: Soft: how soon it reaches full darkness toward its foot and the light (smaller: a bigger dark core).

decisions.label: Width that casts
decisions.note: The share of a trunk's sprite width that casts (smaller: just the trunk; larger: its low boughs too).

decisions.label: A campfire's reach (m)
decisions.note: How far a campfire's light, and so its shadows, reach (it lights the ground that far too).

decisions.label: Bubble size
decisions.note: Every speech and dream bubble's pixel, the witch's and the creatures' (times each one's level share below).

decisions.label: A baby's bubble
decisions.note: A baby's bubbles, as a share of the witch's.

decisions.label: An adult's bubble
decisions.note: An adult's bubbles, as a share of the witch's.

decisions.label: A legend's bubble
decisions.note: A legend's bubbles and dreams, as a share of the witch's.

decisions.label: Pixel style
decisions.note: How every sprite is baked: bold (3 hue-shifted tones, a selective outline) or ref (one tone family, a near-black outline).

decisions.label: Stars through the blur
decisions.note: How much of the tilt-shift blur the night sky takes: 0 leaves the stars sharp, 1 blurs them like the ground.

decisions.label: Tilt-shift from the treetops
decisions.note: The blur toward the top and bottom of the screen over the treetops (the ground's is 1.5).

decisions.label: Wild growth a wave
decisions.note: Creatures each wild area gains every wave (0.5: one every other wave).

decisions.label: Areas with a legend
decisions.note: The share of areas (home never) with a sleeping legend, seeded and spread out; the rest have none (no clearing, quest or legend music). A new map: it reloads.

decisions.label: Legend bombardment
decisions.note: Damage an angry legend's lob or beam does a soundsystem (of 4000) when she's out of its reach (0: none). It always goes for her first.

decisions.label: Legend stomp
decisions.note: A legend turning angry stamps on its own area's soundsystem at once (Ed's 'perhaps'): it only bites if you empty a partying area of the legend's kind.

decisions.label: Restless time with the stomp (s)
decisions.note: With the stomp on: seconds a legend with none of its kind about stays restless before it angers (the time to bring one back).

decisions.label: Legend buff strength
decisions.note: How strong every legend's buff is, from quests and relics (1: as written, 2: twice the effect, a Fan two fans).

decisions.label: Farthest dream (areas)
decisions.note: A sleeping legend dreams of any other kind on the map, near or far, but none whose nearest area lies more than this many areas away (6 cuts about the farthest tenth on the ~96-area map, as 5 did on the old ~196; 0: no cap).

decisions.label: Quest buff strength
decisions.note: Every done quest's buff, this many times as strong as written, however far its dream creature lived (the encounter is the gamble, not the reward). A relic's stays as written.

decisions.label: Dreams from later areas
decisions.note: On: a legend dreams of a kind living in an area later on the route than its own (deeper in). Off: any kind on the map, as before.

decisions.label: Happy legend reach (m)
decisions.note: How far a happy legend (a relic's ally) reaches from its lair to hit the enraged: about 2 areas at 420.

decisions.label: Grace after a hit (s)
decisions.note: Seconds after the witch is hit in which no other blow lands, so a pack striking together costs one hit.

decisions.label: Legend hit flash
decisions.note: How big and long a legend's blow flashes (0: like anyone's, 0.5: twice, 1: three times).

decisions.label: Charge length
decisions.note: How far charges run (their time and overshoot past her), times each species' own: 1 as before round 13, 2 now.

decisions.label: Charge speed vs her walk
decisions.note: Charges run at least this many times her walking speed, on till they catch her walking straight away: only stepping out of the lane, a blink sideways or the treetops get her clear (0: as before).

decisions.label: Winded after a missed charge (s)
decisions.note: Seconds a charger stands winded after a charge that hit nothing (dodged by a blink or a sidestep): the time to land your 💌s.

decisions.label: Leaps lead her
decisions.note: How far a leap aims ahead of her, to where she'll be when it lands (1: all the way, 0: where she was).

decisions.label: Charge turning
decisions.note: How fast a charger turns as it brakes, times each species' own: lower is wider arcs (1 as before, 0.4 now).

decisions.label: Charge momentum
decisions.note: How hard a charger brakes after its run, times each species' own: lower carries more momentum (1 as before, 0.5 now).

decisions.label: Charges hurt on touch
decisions.note: A charging creature hurts every foe it touches on the way (once each), not only its target as it reaches it.

decisions.label: Leap length
decisions.note: How far off a creature leaps from, times its own (1 as before, 1.5 now); pounces land through metres past her.

decisions.label: Pounce carry-through (m)
decisions.note: Metres past her a pounce lands (the lynx's); less than 0, short of her (-1.5 before round 13).

decisions.label: Downed stun (s)
decisions.note: Seconds a wild creature knocked down in a fight lies stunned (she can still invite it) before it runs off home (8 before round 13; Ed: 20).

decisions.label: Chase past their area (m)
decisions.note: How far past its area's edge a wild animal chases her (or her party) before it gives up and retreats home (10 before round 13; Ed: 30).
